rule: Each unresolved item records: what remains unproven; immediate reason; why that reason remains unaddressed; why the concept therefore remains open; and the exact missing architecture or operational binding required.

items.subject: Canonical workbook live resident bidirectional synchronization
items.remains_unproven: The bidirectional sync engine now exists and passes 5/5 local falsification tests, but no deployed app worker has authenticated to Google Sheets and completed an inbound+outbound sync cycle against the canonical workbook.
items.why_unproven: The resident runtime lacks an observed KEX_TEAM_WORKBOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN/credential binding and no app-process sync receipt or Google updatedRange readback has been captured.
items.why_unaddressed: Credential issuance/rotation and deployed app execution are external operational bindings. The architecture now fails closed as UNBOUND until they exist.
items.why_concept_remains: Local fake-transport tests prove conflict, idempotency and schema behavior, but cannot prove Google authorization, network reachability, API quotas, workbook permissions or durable worker liveness.
missing_architecture: deployed runtime secret/credential broker for Google access
resident sync worker process observed healthy
Google updatedRange readback receipt projected into System Journal
restart/retry/quota fault test against real API

items.subject: Atomic coordination runtime deployment
items.remains_unproven: Mongo-backed claims, leases, heartbeat and non-self-assessment guards exist in source and pass local falsification, but are not observed in a deployed app process.
items.why_unproven: GitHub Actions reports startup_failure before build/test execution and no deployed endpoint response was observed.
items.why_unaddressed: The external build/deployment execution plane is failing before application validation; no alternative deployed host actuator was available in this round.
items.why_concept_remains: Correct source plus local tests prove algorithmic behavior, not operational enforcement on the shared team runtime.
missing_architecture: claim/heartbeat/release integration test against deployed database

items.subject: Independent assessment receipt
items.remains_unproven: No separate software model/system has issued the required A/B/C assessment document number.
items.why_unproven: Only the implementing assistant, tests, GitHub/Drive readbacks and deterministic tooling were available. Those are not a distinct assessor model.
items.why_unaddressed: No independent review model/plugin is currently connected. Available installable review tooling requires user connection before use.
items.why_concept_remains: Instruction #10 explicitly forbids substituting an actor-generated hash, test log or identifier for independent assessment.
missing_architecture: assessment task routing separate from actor identity
assessment receipt projection into HANDOFF/IT FEEDBACK

items.subject: Round-robin autonomous team scheduler
items.remains_unproven: The maintenance scheduler is durable, but the complete discovery→implementation→assessment→critique→integration→observation→next-assignment team cycle is not yet driven by one deployed durable scheduler.
items.why_unproven: The new team coordination runtime enforces claims but does not yet execute stage transitions or assign different workers by foundry/eligibility.
items.why_unaddressed: No worker registry with runtime capabilities, stage eligibility, assessor separation and successor selection has been bound to the claim service.
items.why_concept_remains: A lease service prevents duplicate work; it does not create an autonomous multi-worker development cycle.

items.subject: Autonomous maintenance engine operational execution
items.remains_unproven: The maintenance engine now also contains a scheduled Report-03 evidence-sync job, but no deployed app process has been observed executing any recurring maintenance or Report-03 sync cycle.
items.why_unproven: All new app commits still terminate as GitHub startup_failure before application execution. No maintenance heartbeat, Report03 evidence state collection, or projection event has been observed from a deployed process.
items.why_unaddressed: The execution/deployment plane remains unavailable. The new evidence bridge is locally falsified, but the full MaintenanceEngine depends on the app's Mongo runtime and startup lifecycle.
items.why_concept_remains: A scheduled job definition and local bridge tests prove bounded mechanics, not recurrence, durable persistence, or projection from a running shared service.
missing_architecture: healthy deployed app process with Mongo
KEX_REPORT03_ROOT mount/binding to the software-nodes estate

items.subject: Intent-first frontend compile/lint/browser behavior
items.remains_unproven: The intent-first UI and new Report-03 Diagnostic Substrate panel are committed, but no successful build/lint/browser render has been observed.
items.why_unproven: The latest app commit 10bae47c and every R5 integration commit report GitHub startup_failure before build/test steps; the local sandbox lacks the checked-out dependency tree.
items.why_unaddressed: The external build runner remains unavailable and the sandbox cannot resolve github.com to clone/install the complete frontend estate.
items.why_concept_remains: React/JSX source and static review cannot prove compilation, route integration, focus behavior, rendering, responsive behavior or accessibility.
missing_architecture: browser smoke test with diagnostics drawer

items.subject: Human-centred usability evidence
items.remains_unproven: The interface is structurally intent-first and diagnostics-first separation is coded, but usability improvements are not measured with representative users.
items.why_unproven: No user study, task-completion comparison, error-rate/time-on-task measurement or satisfaction evaluation was executed.
items.why_unaddressed: The current round focused on missing engineering/runtime mechanics and had no representative-user test cohort or instrumentation.
items.why_concept_remains: ISO 9241-210 human-centred design requires iterative understanding/evaluation of users and context; layout changes alone cannot prove usability.

items.subject: Accessibility conformance
items.remains_unproven: No accessibility audit or assistive-technology execution was performed on the new UI.
items.why_unproven: The frontend has not been rendered in a browser test environment and no axe/screen-reader/keyboard conformance suite ran.
items.why_unaddressed: Build/browser execution is blocked and accessibility tooling is not integrated into the current CI.
items.why_concept_remains: ARIA labels in source are useful but insufficient to establish accessibility conformance.
missing_architecture: documented accessibility target such as WCAG profile

items.subject: 10-stage construction path full executable continuity
items.remains_unproven: The trace represents all ten stages, but NODE, IL-LLM, compiler, assembler and final IL-LLM-of-seeds stages are unbound in the app repository.
items.why_unproven: No local implementation artifact/source hash exists for those stages in this repository.
items.why_unaddressed: The authoritative implementations may live in other BRAINK/KEX repositories or Library artifacts and have not yet been resolved and bound into this app trace.
items.why_concept_remains: A visualization of a declared transition is not execution evidence. Adjacent implemented stages cannot prove the missing transformation.

items.subject: Diagnostic System Journal immutability
items.remains_unproven: The app ledger is hash-chained and verification is exposed, but immutable external retention is not established.
items.why_unproven: Mongo records can be altered by an administrator with sufficient database control; no external witness was observed.
items.why_unaddressed: No WORM/object-lock storage, signed checkpoint or replicated independent witness is bound.
items.why_concept_remains: Hash chaining is tamper-evident relative to a trusted prior root, not intrinsically immutable.

items.subject: R3 multi-host distributed closure
items.remains_unproven: The ToT safety kernel, vector coordinate directory and Layer-2 reconciler passed local adversarial tests, but real multi-host partition/rejoin convergence and distributed fencing remain unproven.
items.why_unproven: The 30-test execution used local process/filesystem replicas and adapter fixtures.
items.why_unaddressed: No authenticated anti-entropy transport, peer membership service, distributed fencing or multi-host fault harness has been deployed.
items.why_concept_remains: Local vector-clock correctness does not establish behavior under independent host failures and real network partitions.
missing_architecture: optional consensus if globally ordered decisions are required

items.subject: Real network device actuation
items.remains_unproven: Layer-2 controller semantics are proven locally but no real switch/router/FRR/Linux network target was changed and read back through a production adapter.
items.why_unproven: Only generic adapter fixtures were used in R3.
items.why_unaddressed: No YANG/NMDA/NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI or concrete FRR/Linux adapter is bound to the controller.
items.why_concept_remains: A reconciler can be correct independent of whether an actual network device accepts, partially applies or rejects its configuration.

items.subject: Production availability and recovery
items.remains_unproven: Neither the R3 event layer nor v6.8 app layer has production SLO/failover evidence.
items.why_unproven: No live multi-host deployment, measured SLI/SLO, host-loss test, disk exhaustion test or disaster recovery drill was observed.
items.why_unaddressed: The deployment/runtime execution plane is not yet operationally closed.
items.why_concept_remains: Unit/falsification tests prove bounded mechanics, not service availability.

items.subject: Report-03 evidence bridge and workbook projection runtime closure
items.remains_unproven: The version-aware Report03EvidenceBridge passed 5/5 local falsification tests and is wired into the maintenance scheduler, diagnostics API and Diagnostic Substrate, but the integrated chain has not executed in a deployed app runtime.
items.why_unproven: No deployed process has mounted KEX_REPORT03_ROOT, verified the real R5 receipt, persisted report03_evidence_state, emitted a projection event and then completed Google workbook outbox sync/readback.
items.why_unaddressed: Three external/runtime bindings are simultaneously absent from observation: the app build/deployment runner, the mounted software-nodes Report-03 filesystem path, and the live Google Sheets credential/sync worker.
items.why_concept_remains: The bridge algorithm is proven locally, but end-to-end evidence convergence requires independent runtime boundaries to be connected and observed. Without that, the Diagnostic Substrate remains source-integrated but operationally unverified.
missing_architecture: read-only mount or authenticated artifact-fetch path for KEDDEH_SOFTWARE_NODES/event_runner
KEX_REPORT03_ROOT configuration and mount health check
diagnostic API response and browser-rendered panel receipt

items.subject: Standards conformance and certification
items.remains_unproven: The system uses current ISO/IEC/IEEE and ACM references as engineering guidance, but no formal conformance assessment or certification has been performed.
items.why_unproven: Current evidence consists of source, local tests, standards comparison and explicit governance mappings. It does not include a competent independent conformance audit against full normative requirements.
items.why_unaddressed: Formal conformance requires scoped requirements, evidence mapping, competent assessors and in some cases accredited certification processes; those are outside the present local engineering execution.
items.why_concept_remains: Using standards-informed practices is not equivalent to demonstrating every normative requirement or obtaining certification.
missing_architecture: representative user evaluation for ISO 9241-210 claims
certification/accreditation route only where certification is actually sought
